Screenshot Reader

Upload a profile-popup screenshot and this reads off Health/Attack, the substat list, and the 3 equipped skills — best-effort, editable once read. When you're happy with it, export it as JSON and paste that into duel-simulator.html's "Import JSON" to build a combatant from it.

Screenshot
Export
Best-effort readers, not guarantees — everything filled in is a normal editable field or picker afterward, so fix anything that reads wrong before exporting. Substats accept multiple screenshots (each fills in whatever it finds, without erasing the rest); Health/Attack and Skills are read from a single screenshot at a time.
